build_motion_grounding_network: build a MultiLayerPerceptron network to predict full body pose from motion trajectory inputs
create_dataset_with_modules: create a Dataset with RootModule, MotionModule, and MirrorModule for motion data processing
run_motion_training_loop: run the Training generator to train the network over 150 epochs with cosine annealing
create_training_features: create training input and output tensors from motion transforms with random noise and scaling
draw_predicted_pose: draw the predicted pose by running the network on editor features and syncing to scene
